ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider / Octo Tempest federation backdoor + admin MFA enrollment burst
ucs.description: Hunts the signature post-helpdesk-compromise persistence chain: a privileged Entra ID account modifies federation/SAML trust on the tenant (or rotates SP credentials) within the same window it registers a new MFA method on an admin identity. This is the documented MGM / Caesars / DragonForce playbook for UNC3944 — they don't drop malware, they convert a managed domain to federated or add SP secrets so any future password reset is irrelevant.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=false min(_time) as fed_time values(Change.src) as src_ip values(Change.object) as fed_object values(Change.command) as fed_command from datamodel=Change where Change.action="modified" AND (Change.command IN ("Set federation settings on domain","Set domain authentication","Add unverified domain","Add service principal credentials","Update application Certificates and secrets management") OR Change.object_category="federation") by Change.user | rename Change.user as user | join type=inner user [| tstats summariesonly=false min(_time) as mfa_time values(Change.src) as mfa_src_ip values(Change.object) as mfa_target from datamodel=Change where Change.command IN ("User registered security info","Admin registered security info","Register MFA device","Update user") by Change.user | rename Change.user as user] | eval delta_min = round((mfa_time - fed_time)/60, 1) | where abs(delta_min) <= 360 | table fed_time mfa_time delta_min user src_ip mfa_src_ip fed_command fed_object mfa_target | sort - fed_time
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let FederationOps = dynamic([
    "Set federation settings on domain",
    "Set domain authentication",
    "Add unverified domain",
    "Update application Certificates and secrets management",
    "Add service principal credentials",
    "Update application",
    "Add policy",
    "Update policy"
]);
let MfaOps = dynamic([
    "User registered security info",
    "User registered all required security info",
    "Admin registered security info",
    "Update user"
]);
let FedEvents = CloudAppEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where Application in~ ("Office 365","Microsoft Entra ID","Microsoft Azure Active Directory")
    | where ActionType in~ (FederationOps)
    | where IsAdminOperation == true
    | project FedTime = Timestamp, ActorObjectId = AccountObjectId,
              ActorUpn = AccountDisplayName, FedAction = ActionType,
              FedSrcIp = IPAddress, FedCountry = CountryCode,
              FedTarget = ObjectName, FedRaw = ActivityObjects;
FedEvents
| join kind=inner (
    CloudAppEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in~ (MfaOps)
    | project MfaTime = Timestamp, ActorObjectId = AccountObjectId,
              MfaTarget = ObjectName, MfaSrcIp = IPAddress, MfaCountry = CountryCode
) on ActorObjectId
| where MfaTime between (FedTime - 2h .. FedTime + 6h)
| extend DeltaMin = datetime_diff('minute', MfaTime, FedTime)
| project FedTime, MfaTime, DeltaMin, ActorUpn, ActorObjectId,
          FedAction, FedTarget, MfaTarget,
          FedSrcIp, MfaSrcIp, FedCountry, MfaCountry
| order by FedTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let FederationOps = dynamic([
    "Set federation settings on domain",
    "Set domain authentication",
    "Add unverified domain",
    "Add service principal credentials",
    "Update application Certificates and secrets management",
    "Update application"
]);
let MfaOps = dynamic([
    "User registered security info",
    "User registered all required security info",
    "Admin registered security info",
    "Update user"
]);
let FedAudits = AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where OperationName in~ (FederationOps)

             ActorId  = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.id),
             ActorIp  = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)

    | project FedTime = TimeGenerated, OperationName, ActorUpn, ActorId, ActorIp,
              FedTarget = tostring(TargetResources);
FedAudits

    AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where OperationName in~ (MfaOps)
    | extend MfaActorUpn = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName),
             MfaActorIp  = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)

              MfaActorUpn, MfaActorIp,
              MfaTarget = tostring(TargetResources)
) on $left.ActorUpn == $right.MfaActorUpn
| where MfaTime between (FedTime - 2h .. FedTime + 6h)
| extend DeltaMin = datetime_diff('minute', MfaTime, FedTime)

ucs.datadog_query: source:azure.activeDirectory (@evt.name:"Set federation settings on domain" OR @evt.name:"Set domain authentication" OR @evt.name:"Add unverified domain" OR @evt.name:"Add service principal credentials" OR @evt.name:"Update application Certificates and secrets management" OR @evt.name:"User registered security info" OR @evt.name:"Admin registered security info")
ucs.rationale: Scattered Spider / UNC3944 / Octo Tempest is the cluster Microsoft and Mandiant specifically tie to converting managed Entra ID domains to federated, adding rogue SAML signing certs, and rotating service-principal secrets right after social-engineering a help-desk MFA reset — the federation+MFA combo within hours of each other is essentially their fingerprint (documented in the MGM Resorts, Caesar

ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider RMM stack burst (AnyDesk + ScreenConnect + Splashtop + Ngrok/Cloudflared) on a single host
ucs.description: Detects two or more distinct remote-access / tunnelling utilities (AnyDesk, ScreenConnect, Splashtop, TeamViewer, RustDesk, FleetDeck, Atera, Action1, Ngrok, Cloudflared) launching on the same endpoint within a one-hour bucket — Scattered Spider's documented preference is to install layered RMM agents as redundant C2 plus Ngrok/Cloudflared for tunnelling out, rather than custom implants.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen dc(Processes.process_name) as distinct_rmm values(Processes.process_name) as rmm_list values(Processes.process) as cmd_sample values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("anydesk.exe","screenconnect.client.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","splashtop.exe","sra_server.exe","teamviewer.exe","tv_w32.exe","tv_x64.exe","rustdesk.exe","ngrok.exe","cloudflared.exe","fleetdeck.exe","connectwisecontrol.client.exe","atera.exe","action1_agent.exe","syncro.exe","pulseway.exe","itarian.exe") AND NOT Processes.user="*$" by Processes.dest Processes.user _time span=1h | rename Processes.* as * | where distinct_rmm >= 2 | sort - first_seen
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let RmmBins = dynamic([
    "anydesk.exe","screenconnect.client.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe",
    "splashtop.exe","sra_server.exe","srmanager.exe",
    "teamviewer.exe","tv_w32.exe","tv_x64.exe",
    "rustdesk.exe","ngrok.exe","cloudflared.exe",
    "fleetdeck.exe","connectwisecontrol.client.exe","atera.exe",
    "action1_agent.exe","syncro.exe","pulseway.exe","itarian.exe"
]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where FileName in~ (RmmBins)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen  = max(Timestamp),
            DistinctRmm = dcount(FileName),
            RmmList = make_set(FileName, 10),
            CmdSample = any(ProcessCommandLine),
            Parents = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 8)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, 1h)
| where DistinctRmm >= 2     // 2+ distinct RMM agents in 1h on same host = UNC3944 layered-RMM signature
| join kind=leftouter (
    AADSignInEventsBeta
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where IsInteractive == true
    | summarize SsoIps = make_set(IPAddress, 5),
                SsoCountries = make_set(Country, 5)
                by AccountUpn
    | project AccountUpn, SsoIps, SsoCountries
) on $left.AccountName == $right.AccountUpn
| project FirstSeen, LastSeen, DeviceName, AccountName,
          DistinctRmm, RmmList, Parents, CmdSample, SsoIps, SsoCountries
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let RmmBins = dynamic([
    "anydesk.exe","screenconnect.client.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe",
    "splashtop.exe","sra_server.exe","srmanager.exe",
    "teamviewer.exe","tv_w32.exe","tv_x64.exe",
    "rustdesk.exe","ngrok.exe","cloudflared.exe",
    "fleetdeck.exe","connectwisecontrol.client.exe","atera.exe",
    "action1_agent.exe","syncro.exe","pulseway.exe","itarian.exe"
]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend BinName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where BinName in (RmmBins)
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where SubjectUserName !in~ ("SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE")
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen  = max(TimeGenerated),
            DistinctRmm = dcount(BinName),
            RmmList = make_set(BinName, 10),
            CmdSample = any(CommandLine),
            Parents = make_set(ParentProcessName, 8)
            by Computer, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where DistinctRmm >= 2
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\anydesk.exe OR *\\AnyDesk.exe OR *\\ANYDESK.EXE OR *\\screenconnect.client.exe OR *\\ScreenConnect.Client.exe OR *\\screenconnect.windowsclient.exe OR *\\ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe OR *\\splashtop.exe OR *\\Splashtop.exe OR *\\teamviewer.exe OR *\\TeamViewer.exe OR *\\tv_w32.exe OR *\\tv_x64.exe OR *\\rustdesk.exe OR *\\RustDesk.exe OR *\\ngrok.exe OR *\\Ngrok.exe OR *\\NGROK.EXE OR *\\cloudflared.exe OR *\\Cloudflared.exe OR *\\fleetdeck.exe OR *\\FleetDeck.exe OR *\\connectwisecontrol.client.exe OR *\\ConnectWiseControl.Client.exe OR *\\atera.exe OR *\\Atera.exe OR *\\action1_agent.exe OR *\\Action1_Agent.exe OR *\\syncro.exe OR *\\Syncro.exe OR *\\pulseway.exe OR *\\Pulseway.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(anydesk|screenconnect\.client|screenconnect\.windowsclient|splashtop|sra_server|teamviewer|tv_w32|tv_x64|rustdesk|ngrok|cloudflared|fleetdeck|connectwisecontrol\.client|atera|action1_agent|syncro|pulseway|itarian)\.exe$/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| NOT UserName=/^(SYSTEM|LOCAL SERVICE|NETWORK SERVICE)$/i
| bucket(span=1h, field=@timestamp, as=hour_bucket)
| RmmName := regex("\\\\(?<name>[^\\\\]+\\.exe)$", field=ImageFileName, strict=false) | RmmName := lower(RmmName)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, hour_bucket], function=[count(field=RmmName, distinct=true, as=distinct_rmm), collect([RmmName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName])])
| distinct_rmm >= 2
| sort(hour_bucket, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: CISA, Mandiant (UNC3944), and Microsoft (Octo Tempest) all specifically call out Scattered Spider's preference for layering 3-5 different commercial RMM agents plus Ngrok/Cloudflared rather than dropping custom malware — this lets them blend in with helpdesk activity and survive removal of any single agent. The 'multiple distinct RMM tools on one host within an hour' shape is what differentiates U
